title: Logarithmic Functions
author: 62bad940c8d26e69a9738bb7
chapter_outcomes: Know and use simple properties and graphs of the logarithmic and exponential functions, including ln x and eˣ. Logarithms may be given to any base. Understand that f(x) = eˣ and g(x) = ln x are each the inverse of the other. Understand the asymptotic nature of the graphs of logarithmic and exponential functions. State the equations of any asymptotes. Graphs are limited to y = kenx + a and y = k ln(ax + b) where n, k, a and b are integers. Series expansions are not required.
Know and use the laws of logarithms, including change of base of logarithms. For example: Write 3 + 2lg p – lg q as a single base 10 logarithm; Write log₅(1/e) as a natural logarithm.
Solve equations of the form aˣ = b
